A small jewel-scaled fae dragon, no bigger than a cat, coils sleeping on a low branch nearby.
A pure-white unicorn steps silently into the glade, its horn glowing with soft silver light.
A great low moon fills the gap in the trees, vast and molten behind the court.
A portal of pale gold light opens between two ancient oaks, humming with quiet power.
A firebird sweeps overhead, trailing ribbons of ember and copper flame across the canopy.
A procession of fae lights winds slowly through the distant trees, lantern-small and drifting.
A guardian treant looms behind the gathering, its bark-face half-lit, watching without motion.
A shaft of divine light descends from above, pooling on the mossy ground like liquid silver.
A great horned owl alights on a dead branch overhead, its amber eyes wide and still.
A fountain of magical water rises from the forest floor, bending upward in silence like breath.
A constellation mirrors itself perfectly in the still pool, star for patient star.
A jewel-scaled dragon no larger than a sparrow clings to a twig, wings folded like origami.
A unicorn barely visible at the treeline breathes slow mist, watching the court with dark eyes.
Twin portals shimmer between the oldest trees, their edges flickering like torn parchment catching fire.
The moon hangs so low and enormous it seems to rest against the far hillside.
A second firebird circles high above, each wingbeat releasing a slow cascade of cooling sparks.
Dozens of fae lights bob in loose procession, weaving between roots as if following music.
The treant guardian shifts one massive root, the forest floor trembling faintly beneath the court.
A column of pale light descends and widens, dusting everything beneath it in gold.
The great owl turns its head the full slow arc, seeing everything, disturbing nothing.
The magical fountain spreads in a thin luminous sheet across the glade floor before sinking away.
Every constellation visible overhead appears again in the pool below, trembling only when something breathes near.
A small fae dragon lifts one iridescent eyelid, regards the court briefly, and sleeps again.
The unicorn lowers its glowing horn toward the water, and the pool brightens from beneath.
The portal between the trees pulses once, and something vast and gentle presses against its light.
